(ORDER LIST:  609 U.S.) 
TUESDAY, JULY 28, 2026 
CERTIORARI DENIED 
26-5162 DUCKETT, JAMES, ET AL. V. DESANTIS, GOV. OF FL, ET AL. 
(26A129) 
The application for stays of execution of sentences of 
death presented to Justice Thomas and by him referred to the 
Court is denied.  The petition for a writ of certiorari is 
denied.
